headline: Strong execution; float glass ramp-up fuels strong earnings momentum

highlights: Auto/architectural segment EBIT growth remained strong at 69%/247% YoY, supported by strong underlying demand in the PV segment, capacity ramp-up, and improved realisation for its float glass business.

We believe the growing content for value-added products in the automotive segment, continued focus on integrated value-added products, ramp-up of float-glass capacity, and improved realisation supported by MIP regulation could drive a healthy 24% EBITDA CAGR over FY26–29E.

Takeaways from Q2FY27 result, and our views • Against the PV industry’s production growth of 25% YoY, AIS’ auto segment revenue was up 31% YoY at INR 10.7bn, led by healthy volume growth and a favourable model mix.
QoQ margin declined was due to higher logistics and manpower cost partially offset by higher operating leverage on ramp- up of recent car launches.
